author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗುಣಶುದ್ಧಿ ಸನ್ನಡತೆ ಮಾನವನಿಗಿಲ್ಲದಿರೆ
ಹಣಗಳಿಕೆ ಜೀವನವ ಶುದ್ಧಿ ಮಾಡುವುದೇ?
ಮಣಭಾರ ದುರ್ಗುಣವ ಹೊತ್ತುನೀ ನಡೆಯುತಿರೆ
ಹೆಣವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿರುವೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If a person lacks purity of nature and good conduct,
can earning money make his life pure?
if you walk bearing a load of bad qualities,
you are a corpse that is living, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Money cannot cleanse a life lacking character. Carrying a heavy load of vices, one is alive only in name.
